additional_info.subject: ID0372868-DC/SI-D/AT[CY4tJy] - PowerConverter E:34 CRM:00315001667
additional_info.body:
Hello guys, good morning.
After yesterday's intervention, we were able to replace both the converters that had Error code 34.
Afterwards, we tried to charge both outlets without success as the Converter had the known issue of the PowerON = false while begin charging.
As such, since the charger is still in v4.0.11, I applied a hotfix related to this issue which should be solved in the next FW version v5.X.X
After I applied the hotfix, we need to reboot the charger to take effect and afterwards we were able to charge.
Since this issue has been resolved I will proceed with the ticket closure. I just need you to provide me the following information:
Defective part name/MLFB: PowerConverter
Component serial number: (Serial Number of both converters that were replaced)
Logs with marked error:
PowerConverter[1]' changed to true - (2102312VGQLUP9002659SA002200040208FW:DC119PF119H100,F:1,E5)
Active error flags before replacement:
Device-specific error code
(if applicable): Error Code 34
Outcome of wiring checkup: N/A
Commissioning checklist:
Commissioning date:
Field service report:
Date of failure
(see side note): 6/August/2024
Complementary Information
- Power converters:
Converter position and group: TB3 and TB4
Error codes from Converter Display:
This is very dangerous
, as we need to have the charger fully operational and charging to get this information, if the Error Code 34 shows in SCB this is what will show in the converter display
I will close this ticket, please reply to this email with the information that is not filled in and attach the service report.
Thank you and have a nice weekend!
Best regards,
Francisco
